title: त्रयस्त्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The Pandavas take leave of their elders while the grieving citizens follow them, blaming Dhritarashtra. Vidura warns Yudhishthira in a riddling language of a fire that does not burn one who has a hole to hide in, and the brothers reach Varanavata.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರು ಹಿರಿಯರಿಂದ ಬೀಳ್ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ, ದುಃಖಿತ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನನ್ನು ದೂಷಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಹಿಂಬಾಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅಡಗಲು ಬಿಲವಿರುವವನನ್ನು ಸುಡದ ಬೆಂಕಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿದುರನು ಒಗಟಿನ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸಹೋದರರು ವಾರಣಾವತ ಸೇರುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: पाण्डव बड़ों से विदा लेते हैं और दुःखी नगरवासी धृतराष्ट्र को दोष देते हुए उनके पीछे चलते हैं। विदुर पहेली जैसी भाषा में युधिष्ठिर को उस अग्नि की चेतावनी देते हैं जो बिल में छिपने वाले को नहीं जलाती, और भाई वारणावत पहुँचते हैं।
summary.te: పాండవులు పెద్దల వద్ద సెలవు తీసుకుంటారు, దుఃఖిత పౌరులు ధృతరాష్ట్రుని నిందిస్తూ వెంట వస్తారు. దాగడానికి బొరియ ఉన్నవానిని కాల్చని అగ్ని గురించి విదురుడు పొడుపు భాషలో యుధిష్ఠిరుని హెచ్చరిస్తాడు; సోదరులు వారణావతం చేరుతారు.
summary.ta: பாண்டவர்கள் பெரியோரிடம் விடைபெற, துயருற்ற குடிமக்கள் திருதராஷ்டிரனைக் குறைகூறியபடி பின்தொடர்கிறார்கள். ஒளிந்துகொள்ள வளை உள்ளவனை எரிக்காத தீ பற்றி விதுரர் புதிர் மொழியில் யுதிஷ்டிரரை எச்சரிக்க, சகோதரர்கள் வாரணாவதம் அடைகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: പാണ്ഡവർ മുതിർന്നവരോട് യാത്ര പറയുന്നു; ദുഃഖിതരായ പൗരന്മാർ ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രരെ കുറ്റപ്പെടുത്തിക്കൊണ്ട് അവരെ അനുഗമിക്കുന്നു. ഒളിക്കാൻ ഒരു ദ്വാരമുള്ളവനെ തീ ദഹിപ്പിക്കില്ലെന്ന് വിദുരർ ഒരു കടങ്കഥയുടെ ഭാഷയിൽ യുധിഷ്ഠിരന് മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് നൽകുന്നു; സഹോദരന്മാർ വാരണാവതത്തിൽ എത്തുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.133; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
पाण्डवास्तु रथान्युक्त्वा सदश्वैरनिलोपमैः ।
आरोहमाणा भीष्मस्य पादौ जगृहुरार्तवत् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas, yoking their chariots with fine horses swift as wind, and mounting, took Bhishma's feet in sorrow.

verses.text:
राज्ञश्च धृतराष्ट्रस्य द्रोणस्य च महात्मनः ।
अन्येषां चैव वृद्धानां विदुरस्य कृपस्य च ॥

meaning.en: They did the same for King Dhritarashtra, the great-souled Drona, the other elders, Vidura and Kripa.

verses.text:
एवं सर्वान्कुरून्वृद्धानभिवाद्य यतव्रताः ।
समालिङ्ग्य समानांश्च बालैश्चाप्यभिवादिताः ॥

meaning.en: Having greeted all the Kuru elders of firm vows, embraced their equals and been greeted by the young,

verses.text:
सर्वा मातॄस्तथापृष्ट्वा कृत्वा चैव प्रदक्षिणम् ।
सर्वाः प्रकृतयश्चैव प्रययुर्वारणावतम् ॥

meaning.en: and having taken leave of all the mothers and circled them, the Pandavas, with all their retinue, set out for Varanavata.

verses.text:
विदुरश्च महाप्राज्ञस्तथान्ये कुरुपुंगवाः ।
पौराश्च पुरुषव्याघ्रानन्वयुः शोककर्शिताः ॥

meaning.en: Vidura, the very wise, and other chief Kurus, and the townspeople, wasted with grief, followed those tigers among men.

verses.text:
तत्र केचिद्ब्रुवन्ति स्म ब्राह्मणा निर्भयास्तदा ।
शोचमानाः पाण्डुपुत्रानतीव भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Some brahmins there then spoke without fear, deeply grieving for the sons of Pandu, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
विषमं पश्यते राजा सर्वथा तमसावृतः ।
धृतराष्ट्रः सुदुर्बुद्धिर्न च धर्मं प्रपश्यति ॥

meaning.en: "The king sees things crookedly, wholly covered with darkness. Dhritarashtra, ill-minded, does not see dharma.

verses.text:
न हि पापमपापात्मा रोचयिष्यति पाण्डवः ।
भीमो वा बलिनां श्रेष्ठः कौन्तेयो वा धनंजयः ।
कुत एव महाप्राज्ञौ माद्रीपुत्रौ करिष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava, sinless in heart, will never delight in sin, nor Bhima, best of the strong, nor Kunti's son Dhananjaya; how then would the wise sons of Madri?

verses.text:
तद्राज्यं पितृतः प्राप्तं धृतराष्ट्रो न मृष्यते ।
अधर्ममखिलं किं नु भीष्मोऽयमनुमन्यते ।
विवास्यमानानस्थाने कौन्तेयान्भरतर्षभान् ॥

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra cannot bear that kingdom that came from their father. How does Bhishma accept this wholly unrighteous act, sending out the Kunti sons, bulls of the Bharatas, without cause?

verses.text:
पितेव हि नृपोऽस्माकमभूच्छांतनवः पुरा ।
विचित्रवीर्यो राजर्षिः पाण्डुश्च कुरुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Shantanu's son was like a father to us, as was the royal sage Vichitravirya and the Kuru joy Pandu.

verses.text:
स तस्मिन्पुरुषव्याघ्रे दिष्टभावं गते सति ।
राजपुत्रानिमान्बालान्धृतराष्ट्रो न मृष्यते ॥

meaning.en: Now that tiger among men has gone to his fate, Dhritarashtra cannot bear these young princes.

verses.text:
वयमेतदमृष्यन्तः सर्व एव पुरोत्तमात् ।
गृहान्विहाय गच्छामो यत्र याति युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: We cannot bear it either; all of us, leaving our homes, will leave this best of cities and go where Yudhishthira goes."

verses.text:
तांस्तथावादिनः पौरान्दुःखितान्दुःखकर्शितः ।
उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: To those townspeople speaking so, the king of dharma, Yudhishthira, himself pained and grieved, said with great affection:

verses.text:
पिता मान्यो गुरुः श्रेष्ठो यदाह पृथिवीपतिः ।
अशङ्कमानैस्तत्कार्यमस्माभिरिति नो व्रतम् ॥

meaning.en: "The king is our father, honored, our best teacher. Whatever he says, it is our vow to do without suspicion.

verses.text:
भवन्तः सुहृदोऽस्माकमस्मान्कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् ।
आशीर्भिरभिनन्द्यास्मान्निवर्तध्वं यथागृहम् ॥

meaning.en: You are our friends. Circle us to the right, bless us with your blessings, and return to your homes.

verses.text:
यदा तु कार्यमस्माकं भवद्भिरुपपत्स्यते ।
तदा करिष्यथ मम प्रियाणि च हितानि च ॥

meaning.en: When we have need of you, then you will do what pleases me and is good for me."

verses.text:
ते तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय कृत्वा चैतान्प्रदक्षिणम् ।
आशीर्भिरभिनन्द्यैनाञ्जग्मुर्नगरमेव हि ॥

meaning.en: They said "So be it," circled the Pandavas, blessed them with their blessings, and went back to the city.

verses.text:
पौरेषु तु निवृत्तेषु विदुरः सर्वधर्मवित् ।
बोधयन्पाण्डवश्रेष्ठमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।
प्राज्ञः प्राज्ञं प्रलापज्ञः सम्यग्धर्मार्थदर्शिवान् ॥

meaning.en: When the townspeople had turned back, Vidura, who knew all dharma, wishing to warn the best of the Pandavas, spoke this speech, wise to the wise, expert in hints and clear about dharma and aims.

verses.text:
विज्ञायेदं तथा कुर्यादापदं निस्तरेद्यथा ।
अलोहं निशितं शस्त्रं शरीरपरिकर्तनम् ।
यो वेत्ति न तमाघ्नन्ति प्रतिघातविदं द्विषः ॥

meaning.en: One who understands this and acts so can cross a disaster. One who knows of a sharp weapon not of iron that cuts the body, and how to counter it, is not killed by his enemies.

verses.text:
कक्षघ्नः शिशिरघ्नश्च महाकक्षे बिलौकसः ।
न दहेदिति चात्मानं यो रक्षति स जीवति ॥

meaning.en: Fire destroys dry grass and the cold, but not the hole-dweller in a great thicket. One who guards himself, thinking it will not burn him, lives.

verses.text:
नाचक्षुर्वेत्ति पन्थानं नाचक्षुर्विन्दते दिशः ।
नाधृतिर्भूतिमाप्नोति बुध्यस्वैवं प्रबोधितः ॥

meaning.en: A blind man does not know the road nor does he find directions; one without steadiness gains no prosperity. Be alert, now that you are warned.

verses.text:
अनाप्तैर्दत्तमादत्ते नरः शस्त्रमलोहजम् ।
श्वाविच्छरणमासाद्य प्रमुच्येत हुताशनात् ॥

meaning.en: A man takes a weapon not made of iron given by those who are not friends; taking refuge in the porcupine's hole, one escapes fire.

verses.text:
चरन्मार्गान्विजानाति नक्षत्रैर्विन्दते दिशः ।
आत्मना चात्मनः पञ्च पीडयन्नानुपीड्यते ॥

meaning.en: A wanderer learns the roads, finds directions by the stars, and one who masters his own five by himself is not oppressed.

verses.text:
अनुशिष्ट्वानुगत्वा च कृत्वा चैनान्प्रदक्षिणम् ।
पाण्डवानभ्यनुज्ञाय विदुरः प्रययौ गृहान् ॥

meaning.en: Having instructed them, followed them and circled them, Vidura took leave of the Pandavas and went home.

verses.text:
निवृत्ते विदुरे चैव भीष्मे पौरजने तथा ।
अजातशत्रुमामन्त्र्य कुन्ती वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: When Vidura, Bhishma and the townspeople had gone back, Kunti spoke to Ajatashatru, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
क्षत्ता यदब्रवीद्वाक्यं जनमध्येऽब्रुवन्निव ।
त्वया च तत्तथेत्युक्तो जानीमो न च तद्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: "What the minister said, speaking as if openly among the people, and what you answered, 'So be it', we do not understand.

verses.text:
यदि तच्छक्यमस्माभिः श्रोतुं न च सदोषवत् ।
श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्सर्वं संवादं तव तस्य च ॥

meaning.en: If it is something we may hear and it is not wrong, I want to hear all your conversation with him."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
विषादग्नेश्च बोद्धव्यमिति मां विदुरोऽब्रवीत् ।
पन्थाश्च वो नाविदितः कश्चित्स्यादिति चाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: "Vidura told me to be aware of the fire and of poison, and he told me that no road should be unknown to you.

verses.text:
जितेन्द्रियश्च वसुधां प्राप्स्यसीति च माब्रवीत् ।
विज्ञातमिति तत्सर्वमित्युक्तो विदुरो मया ॥

meaning.en: He also told me, 'With your senses conquered, you will gain the earth.' I told Vidura, 'It is understood.'"

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अष्टमेऽहनि रोहिण्यां प्रयाताः फल्गुनस्य ते ।
वारणावतमासाद्य ददृशुर्नागरं जनम् ॥

meaning.en: On the eighth day, under the star Rohini, in the month of Phalguna, they set out, and reaching Varanavata, they saw the people of the city.
